findings.what: Leave check runs outside the booking transaction; an online booking racing recordLeave can be committed as booked on a leave day without being flagged rescheduling_required.
Offer nonce is consumed before createAppointment; a non-DomainError failure leaves the entry 'offered' with a dead link until the sweep expires it and the patient drops out of the queue.
An outstanding offer does not reserve the slot; anyone can book it online during the 30-minute window (patient is returned to waiting).

Reassignment overlap check is read-then-write; the DB unique index only covers identical start_time, so overlapping appointments with different starts (longer services) are not protected under concurrency (same as v1).
listWaitlist does not validate the date parameter before querying.
